dek: RAW WINE New York pours today and Monday in Brooklyn. The Den will be on the floor Monday. Here is how to taste like a pro.

slides.label: What it is
slides.text: *RAW WINE New York*: hundreds of producers making organic, biodynamic, *low-intervention* wine, from around the world.

slides.label: When and where
slides.text: *FIVE-TWO-A at Industry City*, 33 35th St, Brooklyn. *Sunday noon to 6. Monday noon to 5.*

slides.label: Natural wine
slides.text: Farmed without synthetic chemicals. *Native yeasts*, little or no added sulfur. *Wild, funky or incredibly pure.*

slides.label: Taste like a pro
slides.text: *Eat first.* Drink water. *Spit.* Go in with three regions to explore.

slides.label: Ask the grower
slides.text: *What makes this vineyard different?* You will get a better story than any tasting note. *Photograph every label you love.*

slides.label: The Den's take
slides.text: Natural wine is where the *new voices* in wine show up: young growers and family farms. *The Den is on the floor Monday.*

question: Orange wine or pét-nat? Pick one.
yt_title: RAW WINE New York 2026 at Industry City: Natural Wine Guide
caption_instagram:
RAW WINE New York pours today and Monday at Industry City in Brooklyn. 🍷

Hundreds of producers from around the world, making organic, biodynamic and low-intervention wine, at FIVE-TWO-A, 33 35th Street. Sunday noon to 6, Monday noon to 5.

How to work the floor: eat first, drink water, spit (every pro does), pick three regions to explore and ask each grower what makes their vineyard different. Then try the one you can't pronounce.

The Innovators Den will be there Monday with press credentials. We will bring back the growers, bottles and stories worth knowing.

Orange wine or pét-nat? Pick one. 👇
Tag who you are tasting with.

Full guide: link in bio. 21+, drink responsibly.

caption_linkedin:
RAW WINE New York returns to Industry City today and tomorrow, bringing hundreds of organic, biodynamic and low-intervention producers to Brooklyn.

For anyone in hospitality, retail or distribution, natural wine is where many of the most interesting new voices in the category are emerging: young growers, family farms and regions that big lists overlook. A fair like this is the fastest way to meet them directly.

The Innovators Den will be on the floor Monday covering the producers worth knowing for our Brindis series.

Who is the small producer in your industry that everyone will know next year?

By The Innovators Den.
